sources.title: Government of Armenia, General information
sources.note: Directly read formation, constitution and symbols sections. Independence referendum 21 September 1991; 1995 constitution and later amendments. Dynamic current officeholders and numerical claims unused.

sources.title: United Nations, Member States: Armenia
sources.note: Original indexed membership record checked: admitted 2 March 1992. Used for continuing international state identity, not disputed territory.

sources.title: Constitution of Armenia, text adopted 6 December 2015 ,  official English version
sources.note: Directly read Articles 2, 149 and 152, and publication date. Constitutional prescriptions described as prescriptions, not a certification of political practice. Combined with Armenian version as one work.

sources.title: Հայաստանի Հանրապետության Սահմանադրություն ,  official Armenian constitutional text, 6 December 2015
sources.note: Direct text witness, Article 2: Հայաստանի Հանրապետությունում իշխանությունը պատկանում է ժողովրդին: The four-word excerpt իշխանությունը պատկանում է ժողովրդին matches official English power belongs to the people. Editorial scholarly transliteration; no manuscript claim.

sources.title: UNESCO, Lavash: preparation, meaning and appearance as an expression of culture in Armenia (2014 inscription)
sources.note: Original full indexed description read: flour/water, cushion and clay oven, thirty seconds to one minute, family roles and wedding practice. Contemporary described practice, not an exclusive invention claim.

sources.title: TUMO Center for Creative Technologies, What is TUMO
sources.note: Directly read institutional description of free self-learning, workshops and project labs, founders and diaspora educational background. No volatile network counts or promises of planned expansion used.

sources.title: UNESCO, Armenian letter art and its cultural expressions (2019 inscription)
sources.note: Original full indexed description read; ornamental scripts shaped as birds, animals, knots and imaginary creatures, craft practitioners and transmission.

sources.title: Ron Pinhasi and colleagues, First Direct Evidence of Chalcolithic Footwear from the Near Eastern Highlands (PLOS ONE, 2010)
sources.note: Direct research article read. Modern discovery in 2008, publication 2010. Abstract/results give combined calibrated leather date 3627 to 3377 BCE; introduction contains a different narrower range, which is not used. Grass-packing function is interpretation, sex of wearer uncertain.

sources.title: UNICEF Armenia, Setting a new standard for dignified access to water, hygiene and sanitation at schools (14 March 2025)
sources.note: Directly read full report. 2023 assessment of 350 schools/preschools in four specified areas, not a national census; models and January 2025 mobile units at Hovk and Hermon.

sources.title: WHO Europe, Armenia refugee health response, six months on (2024)
sources.note: Directly read mental-health outreach and immunization sections. March 2024 situation and November 2023 to February 2024 outreach; reported beneficiary examples are dated, not current medical advice.

sources.title: UNHCR Armenia, Refugee Response and Coordination
sources.note: Official indexed text read; direct open unavailable. More than 100,000 refugees arrived from Karabakh in one week in September 2023; response plan addressed refugees and host communities. Do not use newer cumulative figures interchangeably.

sources.title: Statement by Armenia, Azerbaijan and Russia, 10 November 2020 ,  Armenian Prime Minister official publication
sources.note: Original indexed statement checked and corroborated with UN document S/2020/1104. Ceasefire effective midnight Moscow time 10 November; arrangements described as terms of dated text, not current status.

sources.title: Armenian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Publication of the initialed Agreement between Armenia and Azerbaijan (11 August 2025)
sources.note: Direct official publication read. Public sentence only establishes publication of an initialed agreement in August 2025; does not imply final ratification, implementation or present border settlement.

batchIdentityNotes.association: Separate post-Soviet republic card, not shared with armenia-1914.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: Historical-basemap outlines in 1994, 2000, 2010; approximate bounds 43.490 to 46.701 E and 38.822 to 41.303 N. No claim that the coarse polygon settles contemporary boundaries or Nagorno-Karabakh status.
batchIdentityNotes.chronology: 1991 independence predates imported start. Final period to 2027 is the exclusive display interval through calendar 2026, not a predicted political endpoint. Public period and ending explicitly state continuity.
batchIdentityNotes.writing: Four-word excerpt in Article 2 of official Armenian 6 December 2015 constitutional text, checked alongside official English. Editorial transliteration.
